description_en: Updates an application service in a Kubernetes cluster
description_zh: 更新K8s集群中应用的K8s服务Service
kebab_example: aliyun edas update-k8s-service --app-id 5a166fbd-0000-0000-a286-781659d9f54c --name service-http --type ClusterIP --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateK8sService

parameters.help_en:
The name of the service in a Kubernetes cluster.

The name can contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-).
It must start with a letter and end with a letter or digit.
The name can be 2 to 32 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
K8s Service名称，需要遵循以下规范：

仅支持小写字母、数字和短划线（-）。
只能以字母开头，并且以字母或数字结尾。
长度范围为2~32字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The type of the service in a Kubernetes cluster. Set the value to ClusterIP
parameters.help_zh: K8s服务类型，当前只支持ClusterIP类型
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The mappings between service ports. Set this parameter to a JSON array. The following parameters are included in the configurations:

protocol: the protocol used by the service. Valid values: TCP and UDP. This parameter is required.
port: the frontend service port. Valid values: 1 to 65535. This parameter is required.
targetPort: the backend container port. Valid values: 1 to 65535. This parameter is required.

Example: `[{"protocol": "TCP", "port": 80, "targetPort": 8080},{"protocol": "TCP", "port": 81, "targetPort": 8081}]`
parameters.help_zh:
K8s Service端口映射表，需要符合JsonArray格式，支持的参数如下：
protocol：必填，服务协议，支持TCP和UDP。
port：必填，前端服务端口，取值范围1~65535。
targetPort：必填，后端容器端口，取值范围1~65535。

参考示例：
`[{"protocol": "TCP", "port": 80, "targetPort": 8080},{"protocol": "TCP", "port": 81, "targetPort": 8081}]`
parameters.name: service_ports

parameters.help_en:
The policy used for external traffic management. Valid values:

Local: local mode
Cluster: cluster mode

Default value: Local
parameters.help_zh:
设置外部流量管理策略：
Local：Local模式。
Cluster：Cluster模式。

默认为Local模式
parameters.name: external_traffic_policy

ChangeOrderId.description_en: The ID of the change process

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code that is returned

Message.description_en: The additional information that is returned
